skills.title: Skills or roles
skills.description: Skills or roles, e.g. python, reactjs, java, devops, product-manager. Names like React.js or Data Science are converted automatically, or paste a listing URL or slug from cutshort.io/jobs (e.g. machine-learning-ml-jobs). Each skill is searched in every city below. Leave empty to export all jobs (jobs sitemap, with details).

cities.title: Cities
cities.description: Optional city filter, one per entry: Bangalore, Mumbai, Pune, Hyderabad, Chennai, Delhi (Delhi, NCR, Gurgaon and Noida), Kolkata, Ahmedabad, Jaipur, Kochi, Indore, Chandigarh, Coimbatore, Bhubaneswar, or Remote. Leave empty for all of India.

maxItems.title: Max jobs
maxItems.description: Stop after this many jobs in total, across all searches. In monitor mode it counts only new and updated jobs. Each job is billed as one event.

startPage.title: Start page
startPage.description: First listing page to read per search (50 jobs per page, newest first). 1 = the newest jobs.

maxPages.title: Max pages per search
maxPages.description: Listing pages to read per search (50 jobs each). 0 = all pages, up to Max jobs.

includeDetails.title: Include job details
includeDetails.description: Open each job page for the full description, valid-through date, employment type, category tags and postal code. Billed as an extra job-detail event per job. Every job always has a short descriptionSnippet.

monitorMode.title: Monitor mode (new, updated, removed)
monitorMode.description: Output only changes since the last run with the same skills and cities: new jobs, updated jobs (title, salary, experience, skills, locations or description changed) and removed jobs (no longer listed), in the changeType field. Unchanged jobs are skipped and not billed. The first run is a baseline that returns every job as new. State is kept in the key-value store "cutshort-jobs-state" in your account.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional Apify Proxy. Not needed normally: cutshort.io answers datacenter IPs directly. If set, the actor switches to a new IP whenever a request is blocked or rate-limited.
